title: 絵のスタイル指定や振り付けの拘束を緩めてSeedanceに判断の幅を持たせると、動きがより柔らかくなりやすい
content: 絵のスタイル指定や振り付けの拘束を緩めてSeedanceに判断の幅を持たせると、動きがより柔らかくなりやすい
tips: 絵のスタイル指定や振り付けの拘束を緩めてSeedanceに判断の幅を持たせると、動きがより柔らかくなりやすい

en.content:
When you loosen the constraints on art style specifications and choreography in Seedance, it tends to allow for a wider range of decisions, resulting in softer movements.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Recently, I've been seeing pixel art videos posted by NOBU and Roco, and I, Tebasaki, am easily influenced…😅

I've never tried pixel art before, but when I gave it a shot, it turned out to be super cute❗️ I think I might get hooked on it😇

Even though it's a cat's paw, when I made it do a hand sign, a human finger popped out, lol
@Dreamina #DreaminaCPP https://t.co/WsEBmM3kWH
